text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11000 and the pilot monitoring read back one 1000 for Alaska 421. The pilot flying set MCP 11000 and climbed, and the aircraft rose from 8979 to 11239. Crosscheck stayed silent, which was right because the clearance, readback and setting agreed for a pass.
